detail.longDescription: The release of xOS 27.2 brings Safari 27.2 with fixes for two accessibility bugs I was personally experiencing. Also a CSS bug where an anchor-positioned element inside a modal `<dialog>` could be laid out offscreen. They weren’t present in Chrome/Firefox so I didn’t pull my hair out, assuming it was a Safari-specific issue. https:// webkit.org/blog/18515/webkit-f eatures-for-safari-27-2/ # Apple # WebDev
